proposals: The Office of the Economic Adviser in DPIIT should publish official linking factors between the 2011–12 and 2022–23 WPI bases for the all-commodities index and its major groups, so users wanting one long series do not splice levels themselves and draw a cliff that does not exist in prices.

The Office of the Economic Adviser should add a year-on-year inflation column for every commodity row in its downloadable WPI index files, not just the headline groups, so items like DAP and diesel can be quoted without a reader recomputing rates from index levels.

MoSPI should label any WPI series served through its API and data connector as compiled and published by the Office of the Economic Adviser, DPIIT, and carry the official inflation-rate field, so the misattribution and missing-field errors this blog had to correct are not repeated elsewhere.

The Office of the Economic Adviser should publish a standing revision table showing each month's provisional and final WPI index and inflation rate, with the weighted response rate, so revisions such as April 2026's move from 8.26% to 8.36% are visible without comparing old press releases.
